comparison.objective: Insert six server power plugs so each dual-corded server is split across two power strips; candidate breaks and collects four insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated plug routing and socket insertion, including cross-body reaches, differ from mandrel stabilization, hammer impact, fracture-force control, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: All six sockets filled and no server has both plugs on one strip versus four valid fractures, all tangs contained, and retained inserts undamaged.
comparison.reason: Both include repeated alignment/insertion, but the record tests redundancy-aware routing and connector mating rather than controlled fracture.
